<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.60.0 -->

## What's Changed
### Breaking Changes 🛠
* [feature] Add server.maxWidgetStateSize config option by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15804
* [fix] Limit client-supplied query string size and field count by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15803
* [fix] Reject spoofed host messages from child frames and scripts by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15800
### New Features 🎉
* [feature] Move vega-lite chart actions to native toolbar by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15806
* [feature] Support integer pixel values for `gap` parameter (#13005) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15850
* [feature] Use `key` as main identity for `st.data_editor` if `num_rows="fixed"` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15884
* [feature] Add `height` parameter to `st.tabs` (#12217) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15847
* [feature] Disable dataframe data export by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15910
* [feature] Neutral treatment for zero delta in st.metric by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15790
* [feature] Preserve st.dataframe row selections on sort by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16020
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* [fix] Reject non-finite float values from URL params by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15799
* [fix] Sanitize dangerous Graphviz link URLs by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15819
* [fix] Virtualize selectbox dropdown option list by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15870
* [fix] Keep viewport gutter around dialog on narrow screens by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15875
* [fix] Surface missing httpx error for auth extra by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15864
* [fix] Honor expose_tokens with st.App programmatic secrets by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15865
* [fix] Fix React Aria dialog overlay stacking by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15876
* [fix] st.tabs panels stacking after widget rerun by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15894
* [fix] Remove flaky Missing Submit Button warning by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15889
* [fix] Escape HTML in pydeck chart tooltip interpolation by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15820
* [fix] Dedupe run_every auto-rerun timers per fragment by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15912
* [fix] Remove redundant keyboard tab stop from file uploader dropzone by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15928
* [fix] Avoid PyArrow 25 thread initialization crash by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15947
* Fix RuntimeError: reentrant call inside _io.BufferedWriter on Ctrl+C by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15949
* Fix IndexError in simplify_number for values >= 1 quadrillion by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15971
* [fix] Sanitize dangerous st.link_button and st.image URLs by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15851
* [fix] Cap server dependency major versions by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15948
* [fix] stop auto rerun on fragment evict by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15932
* [fix] Style selectbox 'No results' empty state by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15967
* [fix] Overlays inside popover: stacking and dismissal by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15961
* [fix] Restore type-to-search in st.selectbox by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15996
* [fix] Fix st.metric area chart fill baseline by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15907
* [fix] Prevent file watcher crash on Windows drive paths by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15951
* [fix] Ignore skill symlinks in generated gitignore snippet by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15963
* [fix] Suppress mobile keyboard for selectbox filter_mode=None by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15962
* [fix] Submit typed number_input value on first Enter in form by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16013
* [fix] Improve hashing fallback warning messages by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16040
* [fix] Bundle the skills meta-skill in the wheel; install it locally (no GitHub download) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16026
* [bugfix] Include decorators in st.echo output by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16068
* [bugfix] Fix inconsistent checkbox margin in horizontal container within column (#13162) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16060
* [bugfix] Fix widgets inside popover-in-dialog being unclickable by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16067
### Other Changes
* [chore] Update emojis/material icons by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15860
* [chore] Update emojis/material icons by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15983
* [chore] Replace cachetools with internal TTLCache by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/16014
